### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #42121 

Problem Summary: When doing insert-ingore or replace without changes, tidb doesn't lock conflict keys properly.

### What is changed and how it works?

Lock keys even when insert-ingnore meets duplicated rows or replace without changes.

issue_context.title: REPLACE statement has unexpected behavior in concurrent transactions
comments: Thanks for your report, @sayJason . We forget to mark unchanged keys to be locked in `replace`, which leads to this bug.

review_comments: The behaviors of this part are not described in the documents yet, we could add them there.
I think this query can be removed.

May I know why the query is unnecessary? IMO, it mean to test the [snapshot cache](https://github.com/tikv/client-go/blob/master/txnkv/txnsnapshot/snapshot.go#L132). We cache (1, 2) here and don't want to see the following select-for-update (L547) returns the cached row. Although, it won't read from the cache even when we forget to invalidate the cache because it will read from lock cache firstly now (also, we won't reuse the snapshot with for-update-ts now). I think it's ok to keep the query since the test point still makes sense.
